name: OCAP Tools
description: Service discovery and product-orchestration tools for an OCAP kernel daemon. Find and consume services via a service matcher plus the contact protocol defined in @metamask/service-discovery-types, and keep demo bookkeeping (artifacts, wallet, phase announcements) that posts to demo-display so the audience-facing dashboard updates in real time.

ocapHome.description: OCAP home directory of the daemon this plugin targets. The ocap-jsonrpc-vat socket is expected at <ocapHome>/ocap-jsonrpc.sock. Ignored if socketPath is set. Default: ~/.ocap-consumer.

socketPath.description: Absolute filesystem path of the ocap-jsonrpc-vat Unix socket. Overrides ocapHome when set.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for daemon calls in ms (default: 60000).

displayUrl.description: Base URL of the demo-display server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7777). Discovery posts service.discovered events so the marketplace pane only shows providers the agent has actually queried; the orchestration tools post artifact, phase, and wallet events.

matcherUrl.description: OCAP URL for the service matcher (e.g., ocap:abc123@12D3KooW...,/ip4/...). Redeemed eagerly at register time when set.

walletUrl.description: OCAP URL of the wallet vat's public facet. Optional; when unset the plugin reads <ocapHome>/wallet-url.env, which start-wallet.sh writes on every launch.

walletInitialBalanceUsd.description: Wallet balance to seed at register time so each rehearsal starts from a known amount. Default 10000.

resetState.description: Clear all plugin state on each register() call (default: false).
